Backgammon League

Delete your account

Last updated: 28 October 2026

You can delete your Backgammon League account and its personal data at any time, in the app or by email.

Delete in the app

1. Sign in and open Settings > Delete account.

2. Finish or resign any online game in progress.

3. Type DELETE, confirm that you understand subscriptions are cancelled separately, and confirm. If you have not signed in during the last few minutes, you will be asked to sign in again first.

4. The app shows the progress of the deletion until it is complete.

If your account uses Sign in with Apple, delete it from the iPhone app: Apple will ask you to confirm, and the app's access to your Apple ID is removed.

Request by email

If you cannot use the app, email panayiotiskpanaretos@gmail.com from the email address linked to your account, with the subject "Delete my account" and your username and tag. We may ask you to confirm the request. We complete deletion within one month.

What is deleted

Your login and email address, username, profile picture, friendships, friend requests, notifications and pending invitations. We also ask RevenueCat to delete your billing customer record. Saved games for that account on the device you use to delete it are removed.

What is kept, and for how long

Completed online games stay in your opponents' history, shown as Deleted player, while their accounts exist.

Gold and purchase records are kept for six years from the deadline for filing the tax return covering the transaction (or from the actual filing date if later), and longer only where another law requires it, for accounting, tax and fraud prevention. They are linked only to the Deleted player identity, not your name, email or picture.

Guest games and settings stored on a device stay until you clear the app's data or uninstall the app.

Subscriptions

Deleting your account does not cancel or refund an ad-free subscription. Cancel it in the App Store or Google Play, before or after deleting your account.
